newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-GIBBS HITS 2ND STRAIGHT CENTURY V INDIA A.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GIBBS HITS 2ND STRAIGHT CENTURY V INDIA A.

text.p: South Africa's Herschelle Gibbs scored his second unbeaten century of the match against an India A selection on Thursday as the game headed for a draw on the last day.
At lunch on the third day, South Africa had scored 190 without loss -- an overall lead of 234 -- in their second innings, with Gibbs on 106. He struck two sixes and 14 fours.
In the tourists' first innings total of 384 for five declared Gibbs, who plays for Western Province in South Africa's domestic cricket competitions, scored 200 not out.

He is the second South African on the current tour to score two centuries in the same match. Last Saturday, opener Gary Kirsten scored centuries in each innings as South Africa cruised to an easy 329-run win over India in the second test.
Gibb's opening partner, Brian McMillan had hit 71 including 10 fours, at the interval.
Scores: South Africa 384-5 declared and 190 for no wicket at lunch. India A first innings 340.
